close_reason: SHA-384/512 added to hash_certid_input; 3 new tests with Python3 oracle
description: hash_certid_input in pkix-revocation only handles SHA-1 and SHA-256. Any other OID returns Err(Error::OcspMalformed). SHA-384 and SHA-512 support needed for CertID hashing per RFC 6960.
title: OCSP: SHA-384 and SHA-512 not supported for CertID hashing
